title: BookingEtaFrame
description: Frame `booking_eta` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver, the shipper who posted the load and the booking's viewers, and dropped when a socket is slow. It currently forwards the internal `booking.eta_updated` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.
